the importance of transparency and the need for a broader international scope when planning for the future development of electricity transmission grids.

a transparent and open approach is the most effective method to support investments in the transmission grid.

the Nordic TSOs need more incentives and more flexibility in the planning process to realize the potential of the internal electricity markets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is an urgent need for a more transparent methodology to support the investments in the transmission grids, in order to facilitate the development of the European electricity market.
the Nordic TSOs have to broaden their scope and become more international, if they are going to play an active part in future developments of the internal electricity markets.
the TSOs need the support of the regulatory authorities to get the incentives for the investments in the future.
